datasets.title: Niger - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Niger with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/niger-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters within three Niger regions (Diffa, Maradi, Zinder), assigning representative points to each cluster, and creating Voronoi-based catchment polygons. Population data from multiple sources (WorldPop 2020, Kontur 2023, Meta 2023) were aggregated at settlement level with demographic disaggregation by sex and age. Building counts from OpenStreetMap and Google were spatially intersected with settlement catchment boundaries to create a baseline exposure inventory for humanitarian planning.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to disaggregate total population at settlement level

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population distribution data (2023) integrated into settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Population data disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) providing demographic structure at settlements

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint inventory (2024) contributing to settlement infrastructure asset counts

sources.name: Google
sources.description: High-confidence building footprints (70%+ and 80%+ confidence levels) supplementing building stock data
